units.source_text: 写完这些日记之后，相隔了十年，我在岛木舅舅家的仓库里发现了这些日记。

en.t: Ten years after writing these diary entries, I found them in the storeroom at Uncle Shimaki's house.

units.source_text: 我写了约莫三十张中学生用的作文纸。

en.t: I had written about thirty sheets of composition paper meant for middle school students.

units.source_text: 大概只写了这些，后来就没有再写。

en.t: It seems I wrote only this much, and afterward I did not write any more.

units.source_text: 因为祖父在当年五月二十四日夜里与世长辞了。

en.t: Because my grandfather passed away on the night of May 24 that year.

units.source_text: 这些日记，最后的日子是五月十六日。

en.t: The last date in these diary entries is May 16.
That was eight days before my grandfather died.

units.source_text: 十六日以后，祖父病情更加恶化，家中一片混乱，哪还能写什么日记呢。

en.t: After the sixteenth, my grandfather's condition worsened even more, the household fell into chaos, and how could I possibly keep a diary then?
